cost.details: Reaction: when you gain a negative condition

effects.text: Heal 1 negative condition (not Wounds). If you were Dazed, regain 1 Action.

description.public:
Gadget · Engineer invention powered by Toolbelt scraps. Activate for 1 scrap; spend a 2nd scrap for the Toolbelt effect. Only Engineers gain the active benefit — an ally given this gadget gains only the Passive.

Reaction (1 scrap): When you gain a negative condition, heal 1 negative condition (not including Wounds). If you were Dazed, regain 1 Action.

Toolbelt (2 scraps): Heal all negative conditions (not including Wounds).

Passive: Advantage on saves vs being Poisoned.

[A] Using the gadget spends 1 Toolbelt scrap — tracked on the sheet (click the counter to correct mistakes).

[A] The Toolbelt upgrade is the separate "Elixir C (Toolbelt)" feature (2 scraps total); the passive lives on the "Elixir C" gadget feature, so it works even if this item is unequipped.

[A] Keep the gadget equipped: Nimble switches off an unequipped object's rules, so its scrap cost would not be charged.

[M] Remove the condition yourself; if it was Dazed, add 1 Action.
